svg.title: An aggregate 'as of today' is a different feature
svg.desc: A customer's transaction timeline cut by a red dashed prediction moment, with a red bracket spanning the whole history struck out beyond that moment and a green bracket stopping at it, above a ledger showing the leaky feature's reported cross-validated AUC of 0.8421, the 0.8076 production actually delivered and the 0.8303 an honest model would have given, plus a clock showing hours 23 and 0 one step apart against a number line where they sit 23 apart, and three text representations sized by artifact.
svg.text: An aggregate 'as of today' is a different feature
cust_mean_all - what the training extract computed
cust_mean_prior - what serving can actually produce
the training pipeline could see the
future. The serving pipeline cannot. That
honest model - correct on both sides
HistGB 4.764 either way - trees can split twice
...and which of these 200 features do you keep? -> M3
